messages:
devon: ran a quick tilt test on mistral-14b-int8 with the new kernel-chooser. numbers look noisy, need eyes.

nina: what's 'tilt test'? cc @sam

devon: small A/B: chooser_v2 vs generic_fallback on warmup+steady run. batch=4 microbatch=1, seq=4096, prefetch on.

sam: can you paste the exact commands so i can reproduce?

devon: ```
./perf_runner --model mistral-14b-int8 --kernel-policy=chooser_v2 --batch=4 --microbatch=1 --seq=4096 --prefetch=on --kv-warmup=100
./perf_runner --model mistral-14b-int8 --kernel-policy=fallback --batch=4 --microbatch=1 --seq=4096 --prefetch=on --kv-warmup=100
```

devon: quick summary (tokens/sec p50/p95/p99): chooser_v2 12.8 / 9.5 / 7.3, fallback 13.1 / 10.8 / 6.9

arya: interesting — chooser p50 slightly lower, but fallback p95 higher. could be kernel switch churn. any RoPE scaling differences between runs?

lee: i think chooser forced kernel-A for long sequences; kernel-A has worse headwise KV throughput on our 64-head layouts (head_dim skew).

nina: did you run AWQ calibration prompts for the int8 path? any accuracy delta?

devon: AWQ calib used our small prompt set. accuracy delta ~0.8% relative drop on our QA eval. details below: 
```
calib_prompts: 200 random QA pairs
AWQ: per-channel scaling, zero bias fold
accuracy: baseline 78.6 -> awq 77.8
```

qa-bot: perf-test-runner finished: job 11234, artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/11234 (logs + traces)

sam: repro notes: if kv-prefetch disabled chooser picks kernel-B and p95 regresses. looks like prefetch + RoPE window size interacts with kernel decision.

arya: also observed more KV-cache misses when head_dim heterogeneity present (96 vs 128 dims across layers). that increases effective latency.

lee: suggestion: heuristic guard: if seq_len > 1024 AND head_dim_ratio > 0.75 -> prefer fallback kernel; else allow chooser. avoids bad kernel for long-rope/large-head configs.

devon: i'll try that. need someone to run microbatch tail test. aim p99 < 2s for interactive tier.

nina: i'll run on dedicated-gpu-3 (80GB) now and collect traces.

infra-bot: canary deploy: kernel-chooser v2 -> cluster canary (deploy id d-7788) completed

nina: first pass numbers: p50 13.0 p95 10.2 p99 9.8 — p99 still worse than baseline. traces show occasional 1.4x kernel switch overhead when KV warmup incomplete.

devon: plan: 1) add guard to avoid switching kernel mid-request; 2) bump kv-warmup to 300 for chooser path; 3) rerun AWQ evals with domain-specific prompts.

sam: also add debug metric kernel_switch_rate per 10k requests and a histogram of kv_cache_hit_ratio.

devon: added metrics in local branch, pushing PR shortly.

qa-bot: regression alert: sample-quality-drop on math-evals when using AWQ per-channel: delta -1.2 accuracy. filed ticket #4012.

arya: we should rerun calibration with domain-specific prompts (math + code) before enabling AWQ for mixtral family. general calib set hides worst-case drops.

lee: and schedule a microbatch sweep: microbatch in [1..8], measure tail latency, kernel_switch_rate, and p95 tokens/sec. this will show microbatch thresholds where kernel choice flips.

devon: thanks — i'll publish a runbook with exact configs, PR link, and attach traces/artifacts once available.

sam: :thumbsup:

nina: ping me when PR merges, i'll queue the full sweep overnight.

devon: will update thread with PR + s3 artifacts.
